pages.text: Altered from $(5)Fire-$(), $(5)Blast-$() or $(5)Projectile Protection$(), $(4)Elemental Deviation$() increases resistance against projectiles, fires and explosions. The downside is that it nullifies the resistance of other armor pieces enchanted with Protection. Maximum level is $(4)IV$() and it conflicts with $(5)Protection$(), $(5)Fire Protection$(), $(5)Blast Protection$(), $(5)Projectile Protection$() and $(4)Vigor$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: While it does provide exceptional defense against the resisted damage types, Elemental Deviation's downside becomes apparent when wearing armor pieces that have Protection: Every level of Elemental Deviation will nullify the same amount of Protection levels on other pieces, making combinations of these two meaningless.
